description:
# sc_pileup [![DOI](https://zenodo.org/badge/1351117924.svg)](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23657342) [![CI](https://github.com/swarbricklab/sc_pileup/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/swarbricklab/sc_pileup/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![Snakemake](https://img.shields.io/badge/snakemake-%E2%89%A57.32.0-brightgreen.svg)](https://snakemake.github.io) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](LICENSE) [![Code style: snakefmt](https://img.shields.io/badge/code%20style-snakefmt-000000.svg)](https://github.com/snakemake/snakefmt) A small, reusable Snakemake workflow that turns single-cell BAMs into **per-cell REF/ALT count matrices** at a configurable set of sites. It factors the expensive, deterministic *pileup* out of the *assignment* step so that: - **genotype demux** (vireo / demuxlet / freemuxlet / souporcell in `snp_demux`) can be re-run and re-tuned cheaply, resuming from saved pileups instead of re-reading BAMs; - the same matrices feed **malignant-cell / clonal** analyses — somatic-variant detection (Track A), allelic imbalance in CNV/LOH regions (Track B), and `cardelino` — when pointed at a somatic / CNV-region site VCF. Design rationale and the wider plan (WGS+microarray panel, demux improvements, cardelino) live in [`docs/design_pileup_stage.md`](docs/design_pileup_stage.md). ## The abstraction ``` pileup(bam, barcodes, platform, sites_vcf) -> per-cell REF/ALT counts at sites ``` The pileup is **genotype-free**: it tallies every barcode at every site, irrespective of donor. Donor subsetting / assignment happens downstream. So the only sample sheet is `config/captures.csv` (one row per capture); no per-donor genotype wrangling lives here. ## Engines | engine | tool | output | consumers | platforms | |---|---|---|---|---| | `cellsnp` | cellSNP-lite | MEX: `cellSNP.base.vcf.gz`, `cellSNP.samples.tsv`, `cellSNP.tag.{AD,DP,OTH}.mtx` | vireo, Track B, cardelino | short, long* | | `popscle` | popscle `dsc-pileup` | `pileup.{cel,var,plp,umi}.gz` | demuxlet **and** freemuxlet (shared) | short | | `souporcell` | minimap2 + vartrix | `ref.mtx`, `alt.mtx`, `variants.vcf` | souporcell clustering | short | Outputs are written under `results////` so short- and long-read pileups of the same capture coexist and can be merged per cell downstream. A summary QC pass (`qc: true`, default) also writes per-capture and cohort coverage metrics as CSV under `results/qc/` — `cohort_metrics.csv` has one row per capture × engine (cells, sites, covered sites, total depth, ALT fraction, …). It only *reads* the pileup outputs, so it changes nothing downstream. See [`workflow/rules/qc.smk`](workflow/rules/qc.smk). \* **Long-read (PacBio) note.** Full-length HiFi reads cover the whole transcript body, not just the 3′ end, so many more exonic somatic sites become observable — this is the main reason the malignant-detection direction is worth pursuing. The `platform` dimension is wired through the config and output layout, but the long-read pileup parameters (splice-aware handling, UMI semantics, SNV-preferring site QC) are **placeholders to be tuned against real PacBio single-cell BAMs** (`params.cellsnp_lite.platform_args.long`). `popscle` and `souporcell` are short-read only for now. ## Tools Each engine wraps a well-established single-cell genotyping tool, each run in its own focused container (public biocontainers / the souporcell image; see `config.yaml` `containers:`), pinned to the versions the original `Demuxafy.sif` shipped: 1. **cellSNP-lite** — the `cellsnp` engine; per-cell REF/ALT/OTH pileup at the site VCF. [docs](https://cellsnp-lite.readthedocs.io/) | [paper](https://doi.org/10.1093/bioinformatics/btab358) | [GitHub](https://github.com/single-cell-genetics/cellSNP-lite) 2. **popscle** (`dsc-pileup`) — one shared pileup that feeds **both** demuxlet and freemuxlet downstream. [demuxlet paper](https://www.nature.com/articles/nbt.4042) | [GitHub](https://github.com/statgen/popscle) 3. **souporcell** — genotype-free clustering prep: [minimap2](https://github.com/lh3/minimap2) remap (optional) then [vartrix](https://github.com/10XGenomics/vartrix) counts → `ref.mtx` / `alt.mtx`. [paper](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41592-020-0820-1) | [GitHub](https://github.com/wheaton5/souporcell) Downstream these matrices are consumed by vireo / demuxlet / freemuxlet / souporcell in [`snp_demux`](https://github.com/swarbricklab/snp_demux). ## Workflow All three engines start from the same inputs — a BAM + barcode list (per `captures.csv`) and a **site VCF** (either `deps.sites_vcf`, or a per-pool `informative.vcf.gz` built on the fly by the optional `informative_panel` rule). ```mermaid flowchart TB BAM["BAM + barcodes
captures.csv"] VCF["site VCF
deps.sites_vcf / informative_panel"] BAM --> CS["cellsnp_pileup
cellSNP-lite"] VCF --> CS CS --> O1["cellSNP.base.vcf.gz · samples.tsv
tag.AD/DP/OTH.mtx
→ vireo · cardelino · Track B"] BAM --> SPL["split_bam / split_vcf
by chromosome"] VCF --> SPL SPL --> DSC["dsc_pileup_by_chromosome
popscle"] DSC --> MRG["merge_cel · merge_var
wrangle+merge_plp · _umi"] MRG --> O2["pileup.cel/var/plp/umi.gz
→ demuxlet + freemuxlet"] BAM --> RMP["souporcell_remap
optional; skip_remap default"] RMP --> COV["souporcell_covered_variants"] VCF --> COV COV --> VT["souporcell_vartrix
vartrix"] VT --> O3["ref.mtx · alt.mtx · variants.vcf
→ souporcell clustering"] ``` With `skip_remap` (the default) the `souporcell_remap` minimap2 step is skipped and vartrix counts directly on the original cellranger BAM — validated to be a no-op for the covered-site matrices. ## Contributions The pileup rules were factored out of, and are heavily indebted to, [`swarbricklab/snp_demux`](https://github.com/swarbricklab/snp_demux) (`rules/vireo.smk` cellSNP, `rules/demuxlet.smk`/`freemuxlet.smk` dsc-pileup, `rules/split.smk`, and `scripts/{merge_cel,merge_var,wrangle_plp,wrangle_umi}.py`), then reviewed and generalised. The souporcell prep rules are lifted from [`souporcell_pipeline.py`](https://github.com/wheaton5/souporcell) (renamer → minimap2 → retag → covered-variant depth filter → vartrix). `snp_demux` is itself a simplification and refactoring of the [demuxafy](https://github.com/swarbricklab/demuxafy) workflow developed by [Daniel Roden](https://github.com/dlroden) and [Beata Kiedik](https://github.com/BeataKiedik), which in turn wraps the [Demuxafy](https://demultiplexing-doublet-detecting-docs.readthedocs.io/en/latest/index.html) package and tools developed by [Drew Neavin](https://github.com/drneavin) at the Powell Lab. Key changes vs the `snp_demux` originals: outputs are no longer `temp()`; the site VCF is generic; the redundant demuxlet/freemuxlet pileups are merged into one; genotype-free (no `--sm-list`); platform-aware paths. See the header comments in each rule file. ## Quickstart 1. Edit `config/config.yaml`: point `deps.sites_vcf` at a bgzipped+indexed VCF (GRCh38, matching the BAMs), choose `engines`, and set the cellsnp `minMAF`/ `minCOUNT` for your purpose (germline panel: `0.01`/`10`; targeted somatic: `0`/`1`). 2. Fill `config/captures.csv`: `capture_id,platform,bam,barcodes`. 3. Containers are pulled automatically from the `containers:` refs in `config.yaml` (public biocontainers + the souporcell image). Run with `--use-singularity`; `run.sh` already does on NCI. 4. Dry run, then run: ```bash ./run.sh -n # dry run ./run.sh -c 32 # local ``` ## Testing A small, self-contained reproducibility test exercises **all three engines** on a public fixture: - `test/data/` (DVC-tracked) — Demuxafy's public OneK1K 14-donor PBMC pool (`TestData4PipelineSmall`, Neavin et al.), subsampled to 10% of reads and chr-renamed, plus the 14-donor genotyped site VCF. Regenerate with [`test/make_test_fixtures.sh`](test/make_test_fixtures.sh), which documents the provenance. cellSNP/popscle use only the positions; the genotypes flow through to souporcell + downstream snp_demux. - `test/golden/` (DVC-tracked) — the expected pileup outputs. - Run it: ```bash dvc pull # fetch test/data + test/golden ./run_test.sh --check # run all three engines, content-compare to the golden ``` [`test/compare_golden.py`](test/compare_golden.py) compares *content* (decompressing `.gz`, ignoring VCF headers) so gzip mtimes don't cause false diffs. CI (`.github/workflows/pr-validation.yml`) runs exactly this on the NCI qxub-runner for every PR. ## Validation The test above proves **determinism**. Separately, the pileup is validated for **correctness** end-to-end: on the *full* OneK1K dataset, `sc_pileup → snp_demux` reproduces the per-method demultiplexing numbers Neavin et al. publish for Demuxafy (vireo/freemuxlet/souporcell). Details, comparison tables, and the one-off full-depth run configs are in [`docs/validation.md`](docs/validation.md) (and the primary write-up in `snp_demux: docs/validation/demuxafy_consistency.md`).
name: sc_pileup: a reusable single-cell pileup stage for per-cell REF/ALT counts at a site VCF
